hé tóng tú rán qǔ xiāo, dà jiā de qí dài huà wéi wū yǒu.
The contract was suddenly cancelled, and everyone's expectations were wiped out.

items.english: Describes being irrelevant or of little consequence

parts.gloss: 没有重要关系 | have no significant bearing on
痛和痒，喻切身要事 | pain and itching; matters of real concern
